ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
ETHOS.Data gives a family of tools one input data catalogue instead of one
copy of the data per tool. The catalogue describes datasets as Frictionless
Data Packages -- file paths, sizes, SHA-256 checksums, original sources and
licences -- and each tool ships only a `collections.yaml` naming the slices
it needs, with no paths, hashes or URLs of its own.

Because every tool resolves the same catalogue into the same cache layout,
a dataset that one tool has already downloaded is found in place by the
next one: no synchronisation, no symlink farm, and no per-tool copy. The
`ethos-data` command line tool inspects the configuration and cache,
exports and verifies offline bundles of test data, and -- for catalogue
maintainers -- builds and uploads dataset manifests.
about.summary: Shared, deduplicating data access for ETHOS tools and workflows

name: ethos_data
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.1.0"

package:
  name: ethos_data
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/FZJ-IEK3-VSA/ETHOS.Data/archive/refs/tags/${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 2805bdc8e550c2e080261028b4a04c90c881ea304a08db171eec3426b2e2a9d6

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
      - ethos-data = ethos_data.cli:main

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - hatchling
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - pooch >=1.8.0
    - pyyaml >=5.4
    - platformdirs >=3.0
    - tqdm
    - rclone

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - ethos_data
        - ethos_data.cli
        - ethos_data.catalog
        - ethos_data.maintain
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - script:
      - ethos-data --help
      - pytest -v tests
    requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - pytest
    files:
      source:
        - tests/

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/FZJ-IEK3-VSA/ETHOS.Data
  summary: Shared, deduplicating data access for ETHOS tools and workflows
  description: |
    ETHOS.Data gives a family of tools one input data catalogue instead of one
    copy of the data per tool. The catalogue describes datasets as Frictionless
    Data Packages -- file paths, sizes, SHA-256 checksums, original sources and
    licences -- and each tool ships only a `collections.yaml` naming the slices

    Because every tool resolves the same catalogue into the same cache layout,

  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  repository: https://github.com/FZJ-IEK3-VSA/ETHOS.Data

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - julian-belina
